limitations: Two continuation known DEV cases with both methods using energy screening; no general superiority or optimum claim.
Timeout counters are last authenticated samples, not final totals or final observer-health proof.
Nested operation and setup timers must not be added without disjoint-scope justification.
Skipped immediate finishes are not equal to avoided source-router runs.

progress.observer_io_scope: Persistence only; full hook overhead requires enabled/disabled measurement
progress.snapshot_semantics: Last sampled active stack; not exact timeout stack. Heartbeat may be delayed by GIL-held work or I/O.
progress.timer_semantics: inclusive nested wall and calling-thread CPU; do not sum categories

counters.local_queue_scope: Current prefix only; excludes other prefixes and pending next layer
